## tscli list keys

List tailnet auth keys

### Synopsis

Return all reusable authentication keys defined for the tailnet.

```
tscli list keys [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --all[=true|false]    Include all keys.
  -h, --help[=true|false]   help for keys
```
